name: What preparation should I do before Maine Results, Inc. arrives to install my vanity?

mainEntity.name: What preparation should I do before Maine Results, Inc. arrives to install my vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before our team arrives for your vanity installation, please clear the area around the old vanity, removing all personal items from cabinets, drawers, and countertops. It's helpful to also clear a path to the bathroom for our tools and materials. If you have chosen a specific vanity that requires assembly or has particular instructions, having those readily available can also assist in a smooth installation process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the bathroom area and vanity of all personal items, and ensure a clear path for tools before installation.
